garage_guard_desc: While the phone is within range of the adapter, starting the engine triggers an alarm: a notification, a voice alert and a black box entry.
garage_guard_note: Works when the car is nearby: under your window, in the yard, in the garage. Regular Bluetooth reaches about 10 metres, BLE adapters up to 30. If the phone is far from the car, there is no way to learn about a start: the adapter has no connection of its own.
garage_guard_sub: the car was started without you
garage_intro: Cars are told apart by VIN. Plug the adapter into another car and the app opens its history by itself.
